subQuests.subQuestName: Prepare a boat for Sakujirou alongside Yoimiya

120110101.text: Kouichi! I'm here, how is the boat coming along?

120110102.text: Yeah, it's... alright, I guess. Um, I was questioned though...

120110103.text: Wait, wait. Should we really be talking about this in front of them?

120110104.text: Oh, don't worry, they're my friends, you can trust them! They came with me to check up on the boat.

120110105.text: Yeah! You could say we're all in the same BOAT here! Haha...

120110107.text: Oh, I see... Sorry, I didn't mean to doubt you, I'm just being cautious. The boat is ready, but I'll have to be discreet moving it here.

120110109.text: Because of the Sakoku Decree. The Tenryou Commission is really suspicious of any kind of seaborne vessel. Even the smallest ones — they'll stop and interrogate us, demanding to know what we plan on doing with it. It's a real nuisance.

120110110.text: I understand. I'm sorry for dragging you into this mess...

120110111.text: Haha, don't be silly. I'm actually happy that you came to me for help. I've always come to you for fireworks, and again this time — so just consider this my way of saying thank you.

120110112.text: Right, I'll go fetch the boat now. I should be back shortly.

120110113.text: Thank you! If it's on the way, you can always pick up your fireworks from my house. Everything was made in strict accordance with what was on the paper slip, you won't find the slightest thing wrong with them.

120110114.text: Alright then. The fireworks show will be starting soon, won't it — you should make sure your new friends get to see it. It's an Inazuman tradition, after all.

120110115.text: Yep, that's the plan! ...Oh! You know what, you should tell them about your past — about the first time you ordered fireworks from my family.

120110116.text: That's a long story, actually... Where do I start...

120110117.text: ...Oh, uh — maybe I'll come back to that after moving the boat here.

120110118.text: Oh, right, yeah. Got caught up in the conversation there, hehe.

120110119.text: Okay, well, I'll leave you to it for now and meet you back here later.

120110120.text: Hehe, lucky he reminded me, otherwise I would've ended up chatting the rest of the day away.

120110121.text: I've been so busy with the fireworks business these past few days that I haven't had a moment to stop and chat with anyone. Ugh, it's killing me.

120110122.text: Of course, Pops is happy to listen to me chatter away... but because he can hardly hear anything, it's difficult to get an interesting reaction from him...

120110123.text: ...Aaaand I'm doing it again, aren't I? Ugh. What I meant to say was, while Kouichi is bringing the boat here, we should try to find some firework materials.

120110124.text: I need to make fireworks not just for you guys, but for those kids and Sakujirou as well. We're missing a lot of materials.

120110125.text: If it's too much trouble, don't worry about us.

120110126.text: It'll be fine. It's actually like this every year, there's always a bunch of extra orders to slot in here and there.

120110127.text: When people want fireworks, it's always because they have something to commemorate. And if they miss the chance, they might never get another one. So, no matter how busy I am, I'm always happy to take their orders.

120110128.text: So, what you're trying to say is that you enjoy the work?

120110129.text: Oh, I do! I really do. Being born into a family of fireworks makers, I feel like since I was a kid, I've been obsessed with watching things go BOOM and then seeing all the lights and colors and...

120110130.text: ...Uh, but what I really wanted to say was: Don't worry about me, it'll all be fine!

120110133.text: Sorry, sorry! It's just that good conversation can be as fleeting as fireworks, sometimes, you know? So when I'm in the mood and I've got a lot to say, I just have to get it all out there in one go and leave no regrets!

120110134.text: Let's head to the city, I think I'll try my luck with some people that I know.

subQuests.subQuestName: Look for firework materials in the city

120110401.text: Ah, just as I thought, he isn't back yet. But not to worry, because actually, I've been hoping for a chance to have a nice long chat with you all day.

120110402.text: Sorry for dragging you with me everywhere... Everyone's been so good to me though. It's all gone really smoothly, hee-hee.

120110403.text: *sigh* Feels like Paimon has barely spoken a word this whole trip.

120110406.text: I felt like I was neglecting you guys, so I wanted to find an opportunity to catch up.

120110407.text: When we first met, I was in a hurry. We didn't have a chance to sit down and have a proper chat.

120110408.text: You guys are travelers, right? So, where else did you go before coming to Inazuma?

120110201.text: Hello, Morihiko. How's business these days?

120110202.text: Haha, Yoimiya, there you are. I thought you might show up.

120110203.text: No need to beat about the bush — you'll be here for the firework materials, I assume? I put a batch aside just for you. It'll definitely be enough.

120110204.text: Huh? Really? How did you know!?

120110205.text: Because a fireworks show is coming up! And that usually means you'll be running all over the place trying to get your hands on some last-minute materials.

120110206.text: I've come to expect it now. There's always a few extras unaccounted for, eh.

120110207.text: So sorry for bothering you every time...

120110208.text: Ah, come on now, you know I didn't mean it like that! I'd sooner have my business go under than turn down one of your requests.

120110209.text: What about you two, are you the ones needing some fireworks made?

120110212.text: Haha, it's no trouble at all, my friend.

120110213.text: Once when I'd had an argument with my son, Yoimiya was the one who came and calmed him down.

120110214.text: I'm hopeless at communicating with him. If it wasn't for Yoimiya, who knows, he probably would've run away by now...

120110215.text: Naw, it was never gonna come to that. He's a sensitive kid and he cares a lot about your feelings. It's just... he doesn't know how to express it.

120110216.text: Maybe if you turned that frown upside down once in a while, he might feel more at ease.

120110217.text: Yeah, I guess I'm probably too serious around him...

120110218.text: Which is strange, because I don't think I'm anything like that when I'm talking with other people...

120110219.text: Don't worry about it! No one's perfect. If you have any more trouble in the future, just come to me.

120110220.text: Even if it's not fireworks-related, I'll happily oblige. Customers come first, always.

120110221.text: Haha, alright then. Everyone's always saying what a good kid you are. Your father must be very proud of you.

120110222.text: Go ahead and take the ore, by the way. It's on the house.

120110223.text: Oh no you don't! That's out of the question!

120110224.text: Don't worry, just take it as a token of my gratitude.

120110225.text: Gratitude won't pay your bills, though... Don't do this to me, can't we just play by normal business rules here?

120110226.text: I already said it's fine. Please, just take it. Surely you've got a whole load of other things you need to get done today?

120110227.text: Um... Well, how about this, then: I'll record this in my notebook, and we can consider it a down payment against any fireworks you want to purchase in the future.

120110228.text: *sigh* There's no convincing you, is there...

120110230.text: Pass on my regards to your dad. Tell him Morihiko wishes him health and happiness.

120110231.text: Will do. You look after yourself as well. Don't push yourself too hard — you don't wanna make yourself ill again.

120110232.text: Everyone seems to really like you, Yoimiya.

120110302.text: Ah, Yoimiya. If I'm not mistaken, you must be here for some firework materials?

120110303.text: Seems like everyone knows how busy Yoimiya gets leading up to the fireworks show.

120110304.text: I'm very sorry, would you be able to wait for a while? I have quite a backlog of weapons orders right now.

120110305.text: No worri— Oh wait, actually... Ahh, yeah, that could be a problem... some worries.

120110306.text: Oh, how about this! Do you need a hand? As long as we can get through your orders, you can help me process my ore, right?

120110307.text: Uh... that will depend on my master...

120110308.text: Oh, you don't mind, do you, Mr. Amenoma! As you know, it's not long now until the Naganohara Fireworks Show starts.

120110309.text: There's still a lot of fireworks left to make. If I don't finish them on time...

120110310.text: Talkative as ever, I see, dear child.

120110311.text: The essence of Amenoma Art is patience and focus. When the mind is disturbed, it will show in the blade that is forged.

120110312.text: If you badger Hajime like this, you will only succeed in disrupting his concentration.

120110313.text: B—But, this is a special circumstance, surely! The Naganohara Fireworks Show is right around the corner...

120110314.text: So give me your ore, and I will process it for you.

120110315.text: Huh!? Master... you mean, you'll do the work personally?

120110316.text: Is that so surprising? It is, after all, the only option.

120110317.text: Thank you for helping out, Mr. Amenoma!

120110318.text: You're quite welcome. The Naganohara Fireworks Show is an important event, this I know well. In addition to this, I am indebted to Ryuunosuke for all the business he has given me.

120110319.text: But Yoimiya... you should plan things more carefully in the future. Do not rush everything at the last minute.

120110320.text: Hehe, I'll try my best. In the future, I'll get some extra materials in to cover any unexpected changes of plan late in the day.

120110321.text: *sigh* Though for you, dear child, no matter how much you prepare in advance, it may never be enough...

120110322.text: Excuse me. I will be back shortly.

120110323.text: Wow, Mr. Amenoma! Just look at the shape and size of these grains... It's beautiful. I'm at a loss for words.

120110324.text: It's been a while since I've seen you take up your tools, but it looks like your craft hasn't degraded one bit.

120110325.text: Of course. I have studied these techniques my whole life... they are impossible for me to forget.

120110326.text: So have Amenoma Art and Naganohara Fireworks been working together for a really long time already?

120110327.text: Back in the day, it was my master and Ryuunosuke's father. The people may have changed from one generation to another, but the ingredients required to make fireworks have remained the same.

120110328.text: Hajime, in the future, this will be up to you.

120110330.text: Hahaha, alright, I won't bother you guys any longer. Remember to come and watch the fireworks!

120110332.text: Kouichi probably isn't back just yet, but let's go wait for him.

subQuests.subQuestName: Head to the designated location to meet Kouichi
Go and confirm the ship's condition

120110604.text: Can't be helped, I'm afraid, this is the biggest and sturdiest boat that I can provide. It's built from the finest Inazuman timber.

120110605.text: Still, I'll be the first to admit that if he's planning to ride this into the storm, it's going to be exceedingly dangerous...

120110606.text: I'm also hoping Sakujirou won't have to use it. It's just there as a last resort.

120110607.text: I gotta say, though, Kouichi, it feels like your craft has improved once again.

120110608.text: Haha, I'm not the one you should be praising. It's all thanks to the guys who kindly pitched in.

120110609.text: To avoid detection, we each worked on our own materials separately, then assembled them secretly in the night.

120110610.text: This is the largest we could afford to build it. Any bigger and there's no way it would pass the Tenryou Commission's inspection.

120110611.text: Let's store the boat here for now, then. I'll fill Sakujirou in when I get back, he'll need to make some preparations before setting sail.

120110612.text: Uh-oh, Paimon feels really worried all of a sudden... Uh... Doesn't helping Sakujirou make you a collaborator in the eyes of the Tenryou Commission?

120110613.text: Haha, maybe it does, but I knew what I was getting into from the moment I agreed to help him.

120110614.text: My family has pretty good connections with the Yashiro Commission. We work very closely with them. And whenever there's a national event of any sort, the other two Commissions come to us, too.

120110615.text: As long as I'm polite and respectful and don't cause a fuss, they won't look to cause trouble for me, either.

120110616.text: And anyway, to your point about collaboration... you've been helping out too, right?

120110617.text: That's true, this was all a collaborative effort... wait, huh? *gasp* Oh no!

120110701.text: The boat is a-ready and waiting. I'll mark the location for you on the map. Before you leave, I recommend that you pack some food and water. You can never be too prepared.

120110703.text: *sigh* After how much effort it took to get back in, it's hard to convince myself to leave again... especially when I'll be going up against the stormy ocean on a tiny little boat... My prospects don't look great.

120110704.text: Well, they won't look much better if you get caught by the Tenryou Commission...

120110705.text: I'm afraid that sooner or later, they are going to find you here. Time is starting to run out.

120110706.text: I'm sorry, I'll make sure to get out of here before they come. I promise I won't cause you and your family any more trouble.

120110707.text: I didn't mean it like that. If we ever ran into any problems, I'm sure I'd figure something out.

120110708.text: But if the Tenryou Commission does catch up to you, then make a run for the boat.

120110709.text: Okay. I won't let them catch me...

120110710.text: But... *sigh* Ah, I guess this whole trip was a waste in the end.

120110711.text: Why did you wanna come back to Inazuma anyway? Is there something you wanted to do?

120110712.text: I didn't use to like this place at all, that's why I left. But looking back on things now, I was really just running away from my responsibilities.

120110713.text: Once I started to realize that, I got restless. I couldn't stop thinking about the people and the things I'd left behind...

120110714.text: So, I... Ah, forget it, what does it matter now. It's too late, anyway. I originally wanted to make up for all my regrets, but instead, I found myself in the situation I'm in now.

120110716.text: Talk to us about it, maybe we could—

120110717.text: If only there was no Sakoku Decree, huh.

120110718.text: Anyway, don't worry, we're not going to bother you about it. We'll keep trying to buy you as much time as possible until you reach your final decision.

120110719.text: The Tenryou Commission... If only they weren't so overzealous, there might be a way...

120110720.text: Oh, that's right! That elderly couple, old customers of ours — their son's in the Tenryou Commission, isn't he? Yeah, quite high up, as well.

120110721.text: That's it! I'll go talk to them. Maybe they can do something!

120110722.text: Um... Are you sure they won't just report me instead?

120110723.text: Oh, don't worry about that. They're really nice people, I know them well. They won't cause us any issues.

120110724.text: Alright, you should get back indoors, Sakujirou. We'll be back in no time at all.

120110725.text: Okay, let's go. Time waits for no one.

120110726.text: Wait, hang on... What about the fireworks? All those materials... there's so many orders to finish...

120110728.text: Oh, never mind. I know, I'll write him a note telling him to sort out the fireworks!

120110901.text: Thank you for helping me with the escape plan.

120110902.text: I wish I wasn't so indecisive...

120119901.text: Question! Doesn't it hurt your voice, talking all the time?

120119902.text: It can get uncomfortable, I guess... But what else would I be using my voice for?

120119903.text: Huh... you kinda have a point.

120119905.text: Okay, story time. So, whenever Kouichi brings one of his friends from the trade association to see me, they always mention how they used to play with me when I was a kid, or held me once as a baby, or something.

120119906.text: But there are so many of them in that friendship group, and I don't remember anything from that age anyway. So I never have a clue who they are.

120119907.text: One time, he shows up with another one of his friends, and the friend asks me if I remember him.

120119908.text: So I'm like, "Yes, I do! You held me once when I was just a baby!"

120119909.text: Kouichi just bursts out laughing and says actually, this is one of his carpenter friends. Turns out he's a lot younger than he looks — just a few years older than me.

120119910.text: I went bright red and must have apologized, like, a million times. Arghhhh, it was so embarrassing.

120119911.text: Ahem, why did you cut Paimon off earlier?

120119912.text: Because what he needs isn't an answer, just time.

120121101.text: Hehe, she's always full of life.

120121102.text: That's my girl, that's my girl...
